A first plan

A first NDIS plan does not need to be rushed

Getting a first plan can feel like a countdown. Providers start calling, there is talk of using your funding before you lose it, and it is easy to sign with the first name that sounds reassuring. There is almost never a good reason to rush.

Our honest advice, even though it may cost us a booking, is to take a couple of weeks, talk to two or three providers, and only sign a service agreement once you understand it. Ask about notice periods, cancellation terms and what happens if the fit is wrong.

When you are ready, we keep first agreements flexible with short notice periods, so choosing us never feels like being locked in.

The council runs from the bay at Seaford and Frankston down and inland to Langwarrin, Langwarrin South, Carrum Downs, Skye and Sandhurst. Frankston is the busy centre at the end of the train line, while the eastern suburbs are newer, greener and more spread out.

The difference

Straight advice, even when it costs us

We would rather you choose us with your eyes open than sign in a hurry and regret it. So we tell people to take their time, compare providers and read the fine print, because a participant who made an informed choice tends to stay, and to be happier while they do.

When you do start with us, first agreements are kept flexible with short notice periods. If the fit is not right, you are free to change, and that confidence is exactly why most people stay.

Before you commit

What to check before you choose

You do not have to take our word for any of this. Here is what you can verify for yourself.

A registered provider

Our NDIS provider number is 4-L7JCZ6S. You can look it up on the NDIS Commission provider register.

Screened workers

Every worker holds a current NDIS Worker Screening Check and a police check before they meet you.

Trained and current

Workers hold first aid and CPR and work to the NDIS Code of Conduct and Practice Standards.

Real reviews

Read what families say on our Google Business Profile, or leave your own once we have worked together.

Check the NDIS provider register

Funding and cost

What support costs, with no surprises

We charge in line with the NDIS Pricing Arrangements and Price Limits, so the rate is clear before a shift. Quotes are free, there is no call-out fee, and we go through your first invoice with you line by line.

We support plan-managed and self-managed participants, and NDIA-managed participants where the item allows. With a first plan we will happily explain how each of those works.

Read the current NDIS pricing arrangements

Good to know

Frankston NDIS questions we are asked most

I just got my first plan. Do I have to sign quickly?

No. There is almost never a good reason to rush. We suggest taking a couple of weeks, talking to two or three providers, and only signing once you understand the agreement, the notice periods and the cancellation terms.

Which suburbs around Frankston do you cover?

The whole City of Frankston, including Frankston, Seaford, Langwarrin, Langwarrin South, Carrum Downs, Skye and Sandhurst. Every suburb above links to its own page.

What if the provider I choose is not the right fit?

You can change providers at any time. We keep first agreements flexible with short notice periods, so starting with us never means being locked in if the fit is wrong.

Can you explain how my plan is managed?

Yes. With a first plan we will walk you through whether it is NDIA-managed, plan-managed or self-managed, and what each means for choosing and paying providers.

Do you have NDIS provider registration?

Yes, number 4-L7JCZ6S. Registration means we are audited against the NDIS Practice Standards and can support NDIA-managed, plan-managed and self-managed participants.

How soon can support start in Frankston?

Whenever you are ready. Once your details and funding are confirmed support can usually begin within a week, but there is no pressure to rush the decision.

Talk to a local Frankston team, with no pressure

Ask us anything about your first plan. We will give you honest answers and let you take your time.

Disability support that fits life in Parramatta

Parramatta and the wider Western Sydney area are among the most culturally diverse parts of Australia. Families here often want a provider who understands language, faith and everyday routines, not just a service that turns up and ticks a box.

Our support workers come to you at home and out in the community, and we take the time to match the right person to your needs. Because we are a registered NDIS provider, every worker is screened and works to the NDIS Code of Conduct, so you can feel confident about who is walking through your door.

We work as a service-area provider across Parramatta. There is no local shopfront to visit; instead, support comes to you, arranged around the days and times that suit your household.
